caption:
Two models forecast India's solar power for 2025. Both were wrong.

They saw five years, 2015 to 2019. A straight line said 92 TWh. A growth curve said 681.

It was 196. One was 53% too low, the other 247% too high.

Five points cannot tell a line from a curve. A forecast is a range, not a number.
